title: Forever Update · Oct 13
headline: **Quiet day:** no new build, hotfix or blue post. Baron Charr's Sceptre came back with a bigger proc, and a Restorative Totems fix is queued for the next beta build.
alerts: **No push access** to bayov/forever-sim and no Go module proxy in this run: the sim changes and TASKS.md entries were sent as patch files.

big.title: Quiet day: no build, no hotfix, no blue post
big.text: BlizzTrack still shows 1.60.1.70338 at Oct 12 20:36 UTC. The last Kaivax posts (dev notes, known issues) are from Oct 8.

changes.name: Restorative Totems → Healing Stream Totem
changes.value: talent % now also scales HST's healing power
changes.take: Dev-marked fixed on forever-bugs #291. **Small HST buff with healing gear.** The sim applies the talent to the base heal only, so it's logged in TASKS.md.

changes.name: Shaman tanking
changes.take: Clay Stone (PAX AU): a "popular discussion" internally but not pursued.

items.note: Newest reveal group: **October 11 to 12** (8 items). Items from the Oct 9–11 groups that the sim's database still lacks are included and marked "may repeat". No tier or Forever-only set piece left "still hidden".

list.take: Strong leveling main hand at 55. The 90 comes from tooltip text only; **the sim keeps 35** until SpellEffect 13442 is checked.
Hybrid Str + SP gloves for Enhancement and Ret in the late 40s.
Ret shoulders that fit the sim's Str + SP valuation.
Slow 3.60 leveling 2H at 33, good for Seal of Command, but only 26.8 DPS.
Left out: needs an AP-vs-Humanoids effect and a call on "+3 Defense".
Left out: the healing vs spell-damage stat convention needs a call.

otherNote: No official balance changes. These fixes are queued for the next beta build (~Oct 15) on the testers' bug tracker, dev-marked fixed. (may repeat yesterday)

changes.name: Immolation / Explosive Trap
changes.take: A frost trap and a fire trap can be out at once.

changes.name: Summon Hawk
changes.value: no longer chases late or dead targets

changes.name: Faerie Fire
changes.value: one druid can't stack two ranks

misc.text: Clay Stone: "horizontal" means a bigger world, not flat power. Small vertical gains between tiers, Dragonspine-style chase items; older raid gear may stay BiS for some specs for years.
No modernization of Classic classes. Respecs get expensive fast and the price resets weekly. No summoning stones (Warlock identity).
Ion Hazzikostas: an account-wide bank is possible "in the not-too-distant future". Alts and Legacy points are core; the level cap stays.
No retail races planned. Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms only for the first years.
Talent tooltips show ranks again (#217). Bountiful Harvest and Luremaster give their extra materials and fish (#309, #310).
The latest official dev notes and known issues are still the Oct 8 posts. Beta runs until Oct 21–22; launch is Nov 4.

tldr.text: **PR #12** adds 9 revealed items to the database. No preset or DPS number moves.
**Icemetal Barbute** is now Str + Int plate at 40, a Ret leveling helm.
**Feardred's Gauntlets** (Str + SP mail, req 49) fit Enhancement.
Tremor Totem stays 30 yd (#301). Seal of the Crusader's +40% is a tooltip bug (#330).
Still 1.60.1.70338. The next build is expected around Oct 15.
